base.rule: Existing checkout; preserve all unrelated; no clone/worktree/stash/reset/clean

protected_originals.rule: Canonical sources, binaries, configs, checkpoints, observers/live signed outputs untouched; record live identities; no signal/profile/restart/resume

allowed_paths.dependencies: Read-only canonical rei_microphysics and accepted temperature_rate_table_001

implementation_boundary.driver: Copy pinned axbi_driver.rs to candidate_driver.rs, rebind canonical imports, per-Driver DIRECT/TABLE provider, no global mutable backend
implementation_boundary.provider: DIRECT canonical AxbiProvider; TABLE accepted Table::load/query and thermal_adapter, original AxbiPoint with same EOS sequence/two rate evaluations; process-local Rc<Table> okay, no parallel chemistry
implementation_boundary.call_sites: Route all coefficient admission and chemistry residual calls via selected provider including geometry_map/evaluate/validate, no mixed analytic residuals/table rates
implementation_boundary.identity: Original compiled identity plus candidate source identities, backend/table/binary/config/contract separate; same new executable for DIRECT/TABLE
implementation_boundary.resume: Reject; absent output dir each run
implementation_boundary.excluded: No background/vector optimizer, dedup, formula/table refinement, fast-math/canonical edit

table_policy.query: Accepted logT interpolation/guarded fallback unchanged, strict EOS recovered domain no clamp/extrapolate
table_policy.diagnostics: Retain exact branch/zero/cap diagnostics; record lookup/fallback/T range
table_policy.load: Accepted table once per TABLE process; no silent reconstruction

shared_output_surfaces.implementation: adaptive_step_to duplicates original adaptive_step except endpoint=min(original_end,target_a); original adaptive_step delegates original_end; pilot advances fixed surfaces, no state interpolation/clipping
shared_output_surfaces.outputs: Full precision gas/EOS T/ne/photon vector+energy/grid/ledgers/counters at every surface; ordinary history/abundances/rejections/checkpoint too
shared_output_surfaces.comparison: Match surface IDs/a, never accepted-step indices

preparation_checks.direct_wiring: q0 and +.01 one attempted copied DIRECT vs canonical step; identical binary64 state/ledger/counters excluding timing/identity
preparation_checks.table_wiring: Small cold/branch/warm point fixtures, all RHS/rates/diagnostics/error parity; do not rerun benchmark
preparation_checks.construction: At most one timed Table::construct, 65537 calls charged, never replace accepted artifact
preparation_checks.review: Fresh independent read-only provider/output-stop/identity/caps; PASS launches four pilots

pilots.other_inputs: Pinned scenario/original conventions, each pair identical
pilots.scope: positive signed only, no full family

trajectory_acceptance.completion: Both backends all17 surfaces/endpoint no terminal failure
trajectory_acceptance.photon_energy_L1: <=1e-6 identical grids, normalization max(sum ref EN,sum cand EN,1e-8 eV/H)
trajectory_acceptance.ledgers: Per-step photon/augmented-energy<=1e-10 cumulative<=1e-8 original positive normalizations, retain dimensional
trajectory_acceptance.solver: Newton<=1e-11, local target1e-5, strict metric<2e-4; differing adaptive steps allowed
trajectory_acceptance.signed_response: PLUS-minus-ZERO table effect requires <=0.1 independently measured resolution error/floor for response claim; unknown keeps HOLD

performance.measure: Process wall/CPU including table load+output; separate load/init/integration; peakRSS/output; steps/RHS/coefficient/lookup/fallback; ratios q0/+.01
performance.amortization: Measured construction/load; estimate break-even only positive steady savings; otherwise NO_MEASURED_AMORTIZATION
performance.limitations: One run/backend/case, order/host, no general/full campaign extrapolation
performance.adoption: Numerical PASS does not require speedup; DIRECT retained

limits.repair: One separately approved targeted repair within remaining prep/Cargo after first failure
limits.shared_concurrency: Max2 scientific processes incl original; max1 integration pilot; controller reserves slot, never preempts original
limits.carry: Predecessor Cargo5 direct672340 lookup606803 benchmark1/1 retained; charge new calls/tests/runs

commands.build_test: CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<new-target> RUSTFLAGS=-C link-arg=-Wl,--threads=1 <observed cargo> test --release --locked --offline --manifest-path <new-root>/Cargo.toml --test provider_integration -- --test-threads=1 --nocapture
commands.environment: Reuse observed staged NCP Rust1.94.1/linker threads, stage only new subtree, preserve relative deps
commands.binding: Freeze source/config/table/binary/argv/outputs/slot/quotas before each launch; implement specified CLI

transition.preparation_pass: Independent changed-surface PASS launches ZERO_DIRECT then remaining listed cases while gates/resources hold
transition.failure: Stop first substantive numerical/identity/resource/parity, preserve partial exact coordinate/field; no relaxation/fallback/restart
transition.pass: Publish scoped comparison/reproduction, opt-in tested interval; longer history requires new allocation/new output identity
transition.boundary: No replacement/resume originals or full-history admission
